title: The Initiative
description: The initiative is the power to make threats that force the opponent to react. Learn to seize it, keep it, and convert it before it fades.

sections.title: Forcing the Opponent to React
sections.content: Holding the initiative means your opponent must answer your threats instead of pursuing their own plans. A stream of checks, captures, and threats keeps them on the back foot.

positions.commentary: White seizes the initiative by challenging the centralized black knight and gaining tempo with each developing threat.

sections.title: Sacrificing for the Initiative
sections.content: Sometimes a pawn or even a piece is worth giving up to keep the opponent reacting. If the attack flows fast enough, material matters less than tempo and king safety.

positions.commentary: White keeps the initiative with active piece play, refusing to let Black consolidate the extra central pawn.

exercises.title: Seize the Initiative
exercises.description: White to play. Gain time by challenging the strong black knight in the center.
hints: Hit the knight with a pawn
